name: web_fetch_url
description: This tool allows you to fetch the contents of a public web page over HTTPS and return it converted to Markdown for easier reading. Use this tool when the user shares a link or when you need the current contents of a known page. Redirects are followed up to 5 hops. JavaScript is not executed, so single-page applications may return only their shell; prefer documented APIs where they exist.

url.description: The absolute https URL to fetch.

max_bytes.description: Maximum number of response body bytes to download before truncating.
